access_choose: Choose the access method (terminal or web interface):
access_denied: Access denied: log in to the console (or the terminal is disabled: start without --read-only and with the terminal enabled).
files_ssh_ended: SSH session closed — reconnect to see the files.
files_title_waiting: Files: available once the SSH session is connected
files_unavailable: Files unavailable in this session (file manager disabled in the console).
files_wait_ssh: Files show up here once the SSH session connects.
highlight_title: Syntax highlighting (MobaXterm style): IPs and MACs in magenta, errors in red, warnings in yellow, OK in green. Only on text that arrives without color.
popup_blocked: Pop-up blocked: allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
popup_blocked_link: Pop-up blocked: click the “Open terminal” link in the answer (or allow pop-ups for this site).
